digest.component_or_area: PydanticAIRunner.run() — Agent call preparation and post-call telemetry
propositions: Extract build_agent_kwargs, log_call_success, and record_call_spend from PydanticAIRunner.run() into a new leaf module src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py as plain functions with explicit parameters

The four inline kwargs-dict fragments (tool_step_limit rewrite, base dict, capabilities key, model_settings key) must be consolidated into a single build_agent_kwargs call at their current location to preserve control flow

The _anthropic_web_search_capabilities call site must remain in runner.py to preserve suite patches that use monkeypatch.setattr(runner_mod, ...) and pass web_caps as a parameter to build_agent_kwargs
PydanticAIRunner.run() must be reduced from 342 lines to approximately 300 lines, and runner.py from 699 to approximately 658 lines, by relocating the three functions
The new agent_call.py module must clear the 100-LOC anti-fragmentation floor and have no runtime imports from runner, verified by AST analysis and structural seam tests
